title: [MAIN] Fix customer GST application posting sequence (Bug 659070)
summary: Fixed a posting sequence error when applying GST advance payments against sales invoices with different customer posting groups by deferring GST journal posting until after customer application posting completes.
key_points: Resolves 'G/L Entry already exists' error when applying GST advance payments with different customer posting groups
Root cause was premature GST entry posting using separate posting instance during active customer application posting
Solution defers offline customer GST posting until customer application posting finishes
Uses shared Gen. Jnl.-Post Line instance from OnAfterPostApplyCustLedgEntry event
Fixes both invoice posting and preview functionality
quote: Defer offline customer GST journal posting until customer application posting finishes.
